messages.subject: RE: Project Harbor - SPA first draft (our mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

Our mark-up attached. The headline points the Tindales have asked me to press: (1) the 100% cap is a non-starter - we have moved it to 25% of the Initial Consideration (£9.475m); (2) de minimis up to £50k and basket up to £600k; (3) general warranty period down to 18 months and tax to 6 years; (4) the non-compete reduced from 3 years to 2; and (5) earn-out threshold down to £5.2m. The retention at 10%/18 months is acceptable.

Jonathan

--
Castle & Vane LLP | 9 Cornhill, London EC3V 3ND
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Harbor - SPA first draft (our mark-up) - internal
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah - internal. Their cap move to 25% was expected. I think we land around 20%. I'd give ground on the de minimis/basket (split the difference) and concede 18 months on warranties, but hold tax at 7 years and push the non-compete back to 3 years given Geoffrey's retained role. Earn-out threshold I'd hold at £5.4m. Will draft the counter for Daniel's sign-off.
